activity.notes: Nizam al-Mulk became vizier under Alp Arslan after the elimination of his predecessor al-Kunduri in 1064 and continued as the dominant vizier under Malik-Shah. He was not a Seljuk sultan; ATLAS therefore uses serves rather than rules. His service ended with his assassination on 14 October 1092.

sources.title: Neẓām-al-Molk — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica describes Nizam al-Mulk's rise to the Seljuk vizierate after al-Kunduri's death in 1064 and his long service under Alp Arslan and Malik-Shah.
